protocol.ratings: uniform: no historical snapshots of ratings; current ratings would use later information
protocol.first_round_undecided: exclude identified values below 3%; never infer from residual; missing information retained and counted
protocol.quality: reject negative category shares for every model; retain original records and audit log
protocol.probability_target: candidate A ahead of candidate B (the two eventual finalists), not qualification or unconditional presidential victory
protocol.uncertainty: nominal Gaussian intervals of the finalist margin; institute-cluster sampling approximation plus between-poll dispersion; common election error estimated only from prior cycles, with no candidate bias correction
protocol.primary_scoring: two finalists on full valid-vote denominator; equal election-round weight
protocol.secondary_scoring: all shared categories including Others, and held-out chronological intervals
protocol.promotion_rule: Do not replace production based only on 2026 or a better pooled average; require gain against simple baselines across cycles and no important regression. Prospective confirmation remains future work.
protocol.forbidden: No candidate-specific bonus; no simulated polls; no outcome in point estimation; no optimization of parameters against 2026. Sensitivities are reported, not selected.
